question: Should CodexBar ship a Phase 1 usage estimate that stops multiplicative inflation but knowingly omits legitimate usage and leaves cross-file reconciliation for later?
rationale: The proposal changes the trust contract of user-visible token and cost totals; code review cannot decide whether an explicitly incomplete lower-bound estimate is acceptable.

options.title: Require complete reconciliation
options.body: Hold this PR for scan-wide event/fork provenance, legitimate-lineage preservation, and sanitized-corpus proof.

options.title: Approve labeled containment
options.body: Accept the interim lower bound only with explicit owner approval, user-facing disclosure, real-corpus proof, and the canonical issue kept open.

options.title: Pause this approach
options.body: Close or pause the branch if its file-local state machine cannot be safely reused in the required scan-wide design.

recommendation.title: Require complete reconciliation
recommendation.body: Hold this PR for scan-wide event/fork provenance, legitimate-lineage preservation, and sanitized-corpus proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner authored the revert and discussion that established the current architecture and proof boundary.
